C0718.title: AI Becomes Shell-Swapping Tool for Illicit Industry: Dai Lan Ao Dai Boss Accused of Using AI to Launder Renowned Designer's Work
C0718.summary: Dai Lan Ao Dai brand owner Hoang Thi Bich Ngoc has been accused of using AI image processing software to remove watermarks and pixel-level disassemble and reassemble the copyrighted works of renowned designer Do Trinh Hoai Nam. After minor manual adjustments, the designs were passed off as original creations and put into mass production. This case exposes a black-market industrial chain of machine
